verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a general API that matches UI functionality across hosting, gateway, inspector or chat. The only hints are a reference page about searching the catalog and syncing a directory, which never explicitly mentions an API, and a community mention of 'API attempts' to trigger a resync. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. None of this shows parity between the API and the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
